seo.aeoSummary: Email header & SPF/DKIM/DMARC analyzer processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/crypto/email-header-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does Email header & SPF/DKIM/DMARC analyzer upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Email header & SPF/DKIM/DMARC analyzer executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/crypto/email-header-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Email header & SPF/DKIM/DMARC analyzer?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/email_header.json or open /tools/email-header?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
